chain.us: A series of loops made by pulling the yarn through a slip knot; forms the foundation of most projects.
chain.uk: A series of loops made by pulling the yarn through a slip knot; forms the foundation of most projects. (Same in UK/AU terms.)

single crochet.us: The most basic crochet stitch; insert hook, yarn over, pull up a loop, yarn over, pull through both loops.
single crochet.uk: In UK/AU terms this is "double crochet (dc)". The most basic crochet stitch; insert hook, yarn over, pull up a loop, yarn over, pull through both loops.

double crochet.us: A taller stitch; yarn over, insert hook, yarn over, pull up a loop (3 loops on hook), yarn over, pull through two loops, yarn over, pull through remaining two loops.
double crochet.uk: In UK/AU terms this is "treble (tr)". Yarn over, insert hook, yarn over, pull up a loop, yarn over, pull through two loops, yarn over, pull through last two loops.

half double crochet.us: Medium height stitch; yarn over, insert hook, yarn over, pull up a loop (3 loops), yarn over, pull through all three loops.
half double crochet.uk: In UK/AU terms this is "half treble (htr)". Yarn over, insert hook, yarn over, pull up a loop, yarn over, pull through all three loops.

treble crochet.us: A very tall stitch; yarn over twice, insert hook, yarn over, pull up a loop (4 loops), yarn over, pull through two loops three times.
treble crochet.uk: In UK/AU terms this is "double treble (dtr)". Yarn over twice, insert hook, yarn over, pull up a loop, yarn over, pull through two loops three times.

slip stitch.us: A simple stitch used to join pieces or start a round; involves inserting the hook, yarning over, and pulling through both loops.
slip stitch.uk: A simple stitch used to join pieces or start a round. (Same in UK/AU terms.)

yarn over.us: Wrap the yarn over the hook to create a new loop; essential for most stitches.
yarn over.uk: Wrap the yarn over the hook to create a new loop; essential for most stitches. (Same in UK/AU terms.)

turn.us: Rotate your work at the end of a row to begin the next row on the opposite side.
turn.uk: Rotate your work at the end of a row to begin the next row. (Same in UK/AU terms.)

gauge.us: The number of stitches and rows per unit of measurement; determines the size of the finished piece.
gauge.uk: In UK/AU terms this is "tension". The number of stitches and rows per unit; determines the size of the finished piece.

working yarn.us: The yarn attached to the hook that you are actively using to make stitches.
working yarn.uk: The yarn attached to the hook that you are actively using to make stitches.

tail.us: The leftover piece of yarn after finishing a project; should be woven in to hide.
tail.uk: The leftover piece of yarn after finishing; should be woven in to hide.

hook size.us: The diameter of the crochet hook, usually given in mm and US/UK sizes; affects stitch size and fabric tension.
hook size.uk: The diameter of the crochet hook, given in mm and UK/US sizes.
